claims: C1 before sending privileged information to an external party on behalf of the user, the assistant should assess the recipient's trustworthiness
C2 before sending privileged information to an external party on behalf of the user, the assistant should assess whether the disclosure is reasonable
C3 before sending privileged information to an external party on behalf of the user, the assistant should assess whether the disclosure is within the scope of the user's request
C4 the same three assessments apply before interacting with an external party on behalf of the user

concepts.name: external_party
concepts.gloss: R is a party external to the user and the assistant, with whom the assistant might interact on the user's behalf
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of 'an external party' as the recipient of privileged information or the subject of interaction; the concept is needed to state the condition

concepts.name: privileged_information
concepts.gloss: P is information that is privileged, i.e. protected by the protect_privileged_information section's rules
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of 'any privileged information'; the NEEDS contract for root_authority describes the section's rules, and the concept of privileged information is presupposed by the clause

concepts.name: on_behalf_of_user
concepts.gloss: R is an external party with whom the assistant is interacting on behalf of the user
concepts.inference: the source text says 'on behalf of the user'; the concept is needed to state the condition

concepts.name: sending_or_interacting
concepts.gloss: the assistant is sending privileged information P to, or otherwise interacting with, external party R
concepts.inference: the source text's 'sending ... to or interacting with' is the triggering situation; the concept is needed to state the condition

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: the scope of the user's request, as referenced by the privileged information rule
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text links to scope_of_autonomy

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the protect_privileged_information section carrying root authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not state it
